local tbWnd = Ui:CreateWindow("UIAgeAgreement")
tbWnd.tbControls = {
  btnAgree = "node/imgBG/btnAgree",
  txtMsg = "node/imgBG/Scroll/Viewport/txtMsg"
}
tbWnd.tbOnClick = {
  btnAgree = function(self)
    self:Close()
  end
}

function tbWnd:OnCreate()
end

function tbWnd:OnOpen()
  local szAllText = self.AgeContentText[1]()
  for i = 2, #self.AgeContentText do
    szAllText = szAllText .. "\n" .. self.AgeContentText[i]()
  end
  self.pPanel:Label_SetText(self.txtMsg, szAllText)
end
